description: Search Yandex — web, images and videos, plus autocomplete suggestions. Zero-config, no API key, no login.
long_description:
Yandex Search MCP gives an AI agent access to Yandex, the dominant search engine for Russian-language content, through the same touch (mobile web) interface the official Yandex app uses. It is the right tool for questions best answered by Russian-language sources: Russian web pages, shops, government and corporate sites, and media.

Requests reproduce the app's own flow — same user agent, same headers, and a cookie session established from the first search page, using only cookies the server itself issues. There is no API key to obtain, no account to create and no configuration file to edit: download, run, done.

## Verticals
- **Web search** — organic results with title, destination URL, displayed path and snippet, with paging
- **Image search** — images with original URL, thumbnail and pixel dimensions, plus the source page
- **Video search** — videos across VK, YouTube, RuTube, OK and other hosts, with duration and provider
- **Suggest** — autocomplete suggestions for a partial query

Yandex News is not included: the news vertical moved to dzen.ru and now requires Yandex SSO sign-in, so it cannot be read anonymously.
